title: Meet Mrs. Basher
content: Here's a little teaser intro for Mrs. Basher, a new stop-motion superhero. (Link to YouTube video)Technical notes:The lighting setup is a yellow gel in front of a soft box, with a cardboard snoot on the key light. Smoke is from a party fogger, and the camera (@60fps slowed by half) moves on a homemade radius dolly. Music by Kevin MacLeod.
